datasets.name: Sentinel-2 multi-spectral images
datasets.verbatim: Multi-spectral images are sourced from Sentinel-2... The Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud system (https://earthengine.google.com) is employed to obtain the Sentinel-2 images and slope data.

datasets.name: SRTM slope data
datasets.verbatim: The slope data is derived from the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM)... The Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud system (https://earthengine.google.com) is employed to obtain the Sentinel-2 images and slope data.

datasets.name: Himalayas landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: According to the interpretation and field investigation of landslides, a total of 3,144 samples were prepared for pre-training the model on the Himalayas dataset

datasets.name: USGS earthquake inventory
datasets.verbatim: The earthquake inventory is from the USGS (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/map)

methods.name: Universal adapter module
methods.summary: A parameter-efficient transfer learning module consisting of layer normalization, a down-projection layer, a nonlinear activation function, and an up-projection layer with an integrated attention mechanism. It is designed to be embedded into existing segmentation models (CNNs, Transformers, or hybrid) while keeping the baseline model parameters frozen.
methods.verbatim: In this paper, we proposed an innovative adapter module designed for parameter-efficient transfer learning in landslide mapping.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom code for the universal adapter module lacks a repository or persistent link.
